questions.question: Where did Amos see the Lord standing in chapter 9?
How does the book of Amos end?
options: With a list of the foreign nations still left to be judged
With a final word of complete destruction of the land
With a promise to restore the fallen booth (tent) of David and the fortunes of his people
With a vision of swarming locusts devouring all the land
questions.answer: With a promise to restore the fallen booth (tent) of David and the fortunes of his people

questions.question: Amos 9 promises that God will plant Israel on their land, never again to be uprooted.
In that day I will raise up the booth of _____ that is fallen.
I will restore the fortunes of my people Israel... and they shall never again be _____ out of the land.
